title: Dead Cert Life
description: Cash out your own life insurance early... by being declared legally dead while you keep on living.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-smooth
lines.text: Why wait to die to cash your life insurance? <p:0.2> Dead Cert declares you legally deceased today, while you keep right on breathing. <p:0.2> Cash out before you check out.

lines.speaker: ad-disclaimer
lines.text: Policyholder is legally a corpse and may not vote or drive. <p:0> Heirs may collect a second time. <p:0> Reanimation void where prohibited. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
